observed_false_green.mechanism: The canonical UCF v1 validator accepted an executed non-plain cognitive cycle while the receipt carried neither a J-Space observation reference nor a selected GWT winner. That permits a receipt-level causal-use claim without the minimum evidence that the proposed J-Space/GWT fabric participated in the cycle.

rules: executed cognitive cycle requires exactly one GWT winner
executed non-PLAIN_COMPATIBILITY cycle requires at least one J-Space observation reference
J-Space observation references must be non-empty strings and unique
blocked/nonexecuted receipts may omit causal-use evidence
PLAIN_COMPATIBILITY may omit J-Space observations but an executed UCF cognitive cycle still requires one GWT winner
repair.authority_boundary: No new state, truth, identity, memory, provider-policy or effect authority is introduced. The patch tightens the existing single canonical UCF receipt validator and its ClayCode law.

bounded_execution_evidence.pre_fix_discriminator: Exact pre-fix validator blob accepted all three poisoned causal-evidence omissions.

grf.R0_OBSERVED: UCF v1 had fields for J-Space observation references and GWT winners, but executed inference did not require either to be evidenced.
grf.R1_INFERRED: An executed receipt could therefore overstate causal participation of the Unified Cognitive Fabric.
R2_GENERATED: require evidence only for executed non-plain cycles
require evidence for every receipt including blocked cycles
grf.R3_COUNTER_REALITY: Some legitimate compatibility or blocked cycles have no J-Space observation; a blanket nonempty rule would falsely reject them.
grf.R4_INTERVENTION: Poison the canonical valid fixture by removing J-Space observation refs and/or the GWT winner, then compare pre-fix and patched validators.
grf.R5_EMERGENT: Causal coupling should be evidenced at the cycle boundary, not inferred from architecture configuration or merely from carrying a J-Space/GWT schema.
grf.R6_VERIFIED: SOURCE_MECHANISM_SUPPORTED: the false-green exists on exact pre-fix bytes and the bounded patch closes it on exact branch bytes. Runtime causality remains unverified.

coordination.parallel_overlap_search: No open PR was found for jspace_observation_refs/GWT-winner causal coupling at selection time.
coordination.reason: No admitted credentialed FREE_ONLY model-execution child surface was exposed to this organ.

next_exact_gate: On an actually-started authorized exact-source Ubuntu runtime, emit a canonical UCF receipt from a real cycle and prove that executed non-plain cycles carry real J-Space observation references plus one GWT winner, while absent evidence fails closed. Then run the adjacent/full exact-source regression suite before runtime promotion.
